mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ship_runtime_status ( ship_id, sailing_status, latitude, longitude, speed, heading, engine_load, fuel_percent, weather_id, last_update ) VALUES ( #{shipId}, #{sailingStatus}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{speed}, #{heading}, #{engineLoad}, #{fuelPercent}, #{weatherId}, #{lastUpdate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ship_runtime_status SET sailing_status = #{sailingStatus}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, speed = #{speed}, heading = #{heading}, engine_load = #{engineLoad}, fuel_percent = #{fuelPercent}, weather_id = #{weatherId}, last_update = #{lastUpdate} WHERE ship_id = #{shipId}
